title: Memory-leak soak
proves: Over the run, no sampled series (RSS, heap, handles, Redis clients, Postgres connections) shows sustained growth above 10 MB/h with a 95% interval above zero.
doesNotProve: The absence of a slow leak: a 5 or 20 minute run cannot settle it; only the 24 h run (--minutes 1440) on a quiet machine can.
